snippet.title: Winx Club: The Magic is Back Console Game | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
The Winx Club is back… on console! ✨🧚‍♀️
Something strange is happening at Alfea and it looks like the Trix are behind it!
Join the Winx on a brand-new magical adventure, uncover the mystery, and help save the school of fairies once again. Are you ready to transform and play? 

Available April 2026 on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 and Steam!

#winxclub #winxclubofficial #winxclubthemagicisback #themagicisback


✨ WELCOME TO ALFEA! ✨

Subscribe for new videos every week ► https://bit.ly/3kZNLDs

🧚‍♀️ Catch all the Winx Club episodes:

🎶 Don’t miss the Winx in Concert ► https://bit.ly/3wyRDF8

🛍️ Visit the Winx Club Official Shop https://winxclubshop.com

WINX CLUB: Six fairies, six friends, one amazing saga! 
Join Bloom, Stella, Flora, Aisha, Tecna, and Musa as they transform into super-heroines and fight against evil to save the Magic Dimension! Endless magic, friendship, romance, fashion, and adventure await!
